bio.text: Chris Deluzio was elected in 2022 to represent Pennsylvania's 17th Congressional District, which includes Beaver County and part of Allegheny County.
A native of Thornburg, he graduated from the U.S. Naval Academy and served as a U.S. Navy surface warfare officer, including a tour with U.S. Army Civil Affairs in Iraq.
He earned a law degree from Georgetown Law, clerked for a federal judge, and worked on voting rights and election security at the Brennan Center for Justice and Pitt Cyber.
